verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents an official MCP server (both a docs-search MCP server and a data/meeting MCP server) with configuration instructions, OAuth-based ChatGPT connection, and specific tools like fireflies_share_meeting and fireflies_move_meeting, letting agents query meeting data directly. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of the MCP server's reliability and broader third-party corroboration beyond vendor docs.
